title: 第4章与朱竹清开房，欠收拾的唐三和小舞-《斗罗V：开局绑定朱竹清，创建神级家族》
content:
第(1/3)页

    朱竹清见自己不能动了，感知到胸口传来的压迫感，又惊又怕。

    若是叶寒要玷污她，她宁愿以死明志，保住贞洁。

    “好了，我们已经出来了，刚才多有得罪。”

    “你在这里等着，我去弄点吃的。”

    “我们今晚就在这里休息一夜。”

    叶寒有点气喘吁吁地将朱竹清放下，解开她的穴位，开启火眼金睛，纵身离开。

    天色虽然昏暗，但火眼金睛的视线却不受任何影响，反而还能看到很多细节，就连一百米外的小蚂蚁都能看得一清二楚。

    朱竹清望着离开的叶寒，轻拍胸口，眼神中满是委屈和不甘。

    刚才叶寒的行为，已经占尽了她的便宜，严重践踏了她的尊严。

    可是她又打不过，只能选择隐忍。

    眼下，她还需要让叶寒护着她前往史莱克学院。

    但是她不会原谅叶寒扛着她的行为。

    不知过了多久，叶寒提着一只野兔子和一堆柴火回来了。

    他把兔子收拾干净，将柴火堆在一起，唤出嗜血魔剑和噬魂刃，利用金属剧烈摩擦原理，让其产生火花，将眼前的干柴点燃。

    不一会儿，香气扑鼻的烤肉味便传入朱竹清的鼻中。

    浓厚的香气，让她忍不住直吞口水。

    自从逃离家族后，她便没有吃过烤肉了。

    “饿了吧！”

    叶寒知道她饿了，撕下一条后腿肉，递了过去。

    “不用，我不饿！”

    朱竹清还在气头上，可不想这么轻易向叶寒低头，忍住诱惑，背对着他，啃着白天仅剩下的干粮。

    叶寒见她不吃，也不强求，将后腿肉放在朱竹清的面前，随便吃了几口，便将剩下的烤兔切成块状，方便携带，充当明天的口粮。

    到了深夜，冷风呼啸，气温以肉眼可见的速度降低。

    纵然有篝火取暖，但气温还是很冷，宛如刀割一般。

    朱竹清只穿了一件单薄的衣服，根本就扛不住冷风的吹刮，冷得她浑身直打哆嗦，卷成一团。

    正在打坐修炼养神的叶寒，看到了她的情况，解下身上唯一一件衣服，给她披上。

    朱竹清感知到他的行为，可不会轻易领情，将其扔了回来。

    叶寒也没说什么，继续给她披上，并主动挪动位置，替她挡下风口。

    朱竹清见冷风降低了不少，打算将衣服再次扔回去的时候，她发现，叶寒竟然用他那满身伤疤的单薄身体为她挡风。

    如此行为，多少让她有点感动。

    心中的委屈和怒意也瞬间消减了不少。

    “我知道你很委屈，也能感受到你的经历很不堪。”

    “但只要还活着，就还有希望。”

    “你只吃那点干粮，不足以让你保存体温。”

    “想要活着，你就要把烤肉吃了，把衣服披上。”

    “你放心，我的身体很壮，不怕冷，也不会生病。”

    “你尽管好好休息，我负责守夜。”

    叶寒说了几句，便闭目养神，修炼起来，给朱竹清一个充足的台阶下。

    朱竹清听着他这番话，犹豫了片刻，便不再拒绝叶寒的好意，披上衣服，拿起已经冷透的烤兔肉，大口啃食起来。

    是啊！

    她要活着，才有机会逆天改命。

    叶寒见她终于吃东西了，暗自松了口气。

    他真怕朱竹清不吃东西，不披上他的衣服，冻死在这里。

    或许是太无聊了，也有可能太冷了，叶寒在守夜的时候，将系统商城打开，看看能否兑换一些东西。

    当他打开系统商城后，才发现里面的东西到底有多贵，为何需要积攒一万兑换值才能激活。

    只因系统商城有一万兑换值最低消费门槛。
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Seeing that he could no longer move, Zhu Zhuqing felt a sense of pressure coming from his chest, and was shocked and frightened.

If Ye Han wanted to taint her, she would rather die to show her determination and keep her chastity.

"Okay, we've come out. We were offended just now."

"You wait here, I'll get something to eat."

"We will rest here tonight."

Ye Han was a little out of breath as he put Zhu Zhuqing down, unlocked her acupuncture points, opened his piercing eyes, and jumped away.

Although the sky is dim, the sharp eyesight is not affected in any way. On the contrary, you can still see many details. Even the little ants a hundred meters away can be seen clearly.

Zhu Zhuqing looked at Ye Han leaving and patted his chest, his eyes full of grievance and unwillingness.

Ye Han’s behavior just now has taken advantage of her and seriously trampled on her dignity.

But she couldn’t beat him, so she could only choose to endure it.

Right now, she still needs to let Ye Han escort her to Shrek Academy.

But she will not forgive Ye Han for carrying her.

I don’t know how long it took, but Ye Han came back carrying a wild rabbit and a pile of firewood.

He cleaned up the rabbit, piled the firewood together, summoned the Bloodthirsty Demon Sword and the Soul-Eating Blade, and used the principle of violent metal friction to generate sparks and ignite the dry firewood in front of him.

After a while, the fragrant smell of barbecue reached Zhu Zhuqing's nose.

The strong aroma made her salivate.

Since she ran away from her family, she has not eaten barbecue.

“You must be hungry!”

Ye Han knew she was hungry, so he tore off a piece of hind leg meat and handed it to her.

"No, I'm not hungry!"

Zhu Zhuqing was still angry, but he didn't want to bow to Ye Han so easily. He resisted the temptation, turned his back to him, and ate the only dry food left during the day.

Seeing that she didn’t want to eat it, Ye Han didn’t force it. He placed the hind leg meat in front of Zhu Zhuqing, ate a few bites, and then cut the remaining roast rabbit into cubes for easy portability and as tomorrow’s rations.

Late at night, the cold wind howls and the temperature drops at a speed visible to the naked eye.

Even though there was a bonfire for warmth, the temperature was still very cold, like a knife cutting through the air.

Zhu Zhuqing only wore a thin piece of clothing, which could not withstand the cold wind. The cold made her shiver all over and curl up into a ball.

Ye Han, who was meditating and recuperating, saw her condition, took off the only piece of clothing on his body and put it on her.

Zhu Zhuqing sensed his behavior and would not appreciate it easily, so he threw him back.

Ye Han didn't say anything, he continued to put it on her, and took the initiative to move his position to block the wind for her.

Zhu Zhuqing saw that the cold wind had dropped a lot, and when she was about to throw her clothes back again, she discovered that Ye Han used his thin body covered with scars to shield her from the wind.

Such behavior somewhat touched her.

The grievance and anger in my heart also disappeared a lot in an instant.

"I know you are wronged, and I can also feel that your experience is unbearable."

"But as long as you are alive, there is still hope."

"You only eat that little dry food, which is not enough for you to preserve your body temperature."

"If you want to live, you have to eat the barbecue and put on your clothes."

“Don’t worry, I’m very strong, I’m not afraid of the cold, and I won’t get sick.”

"You just have a good rest, I'll be responsible for keeping watch."

Ye Han said a few words, then closed his eyes to rest, and began to practice, giving Zhu Zhuqing a sufficient step forward.

After hearing what he said, Zhu Zhuqing hesitated for a moment, then no longer refused Ye Han's kindness, put on his clothes, picked up the already cold roast rabbit, and started to eat it.

yes!

She has to live to have a chance to change her destiny.

Seeing that she finally ate, Ye Han secretly breathed a sigh of relief.

He was really afraid that Zhu Zhuqing would freeze to death here without eating or putting on his clothes.

Maybe it was too boring, or maybe it was too cold. While keeping watch, Ye Han opened the system mall to see if he could exchange for something.

When he opened the system mall, he discovered how expensive the items inside were, and why he needed to accumulate 10,000 exchange points before he could activate them.

Just because the system mall has a minimum consumption threshold of 10,000 redemption values.
